CustomField.description: Accrued to Date + Carried In - Used. Availability is capped by accrual, not by full entitlement, which is what stops December's day being spent in January. Maintained by LeaveAccrualService alongside Accrued_To_Date__c - see that field for what writes it and when. Replaces the Available_Days__c formula. Never edit by hand - the next save recomputes it.
